conditions: Bane pays out only if the Kullervo boss and the Orowyrm both die in the same run; killing Kullervo and leaving gives nothing
Kullervo's Hold does not exist during Joy or Envy, so two of the five 2-hour mood windows are dead time
Steel Path pays 6-8 Bane a run instead of 4-6
Run The Duviri Experience, not The Lone Story; the Hold is a side objective only in the Experience
Pathos Clamps are immune to Resource Boosters
bonuses: Ueymag for both the Chassis and the Systems comes off these same runs
Resources are kept once you earn a Decree, so an abandoned run still keeps the pickups
The Orowyrm that ends every Bane run drops all 10 Pathos Clamps in one kill

disclosures.title: how to beat Kullervo
disclosures.body: Three sequential health bars, fought as the Drifter. Primaries do half damage and secondaries two thirds, but finishers do 1.1x. Phase 1 is Collective Curse and the Storm of Ukko knife rain, which a precise Sirocco shot interrupts; phase 2 spawns five blade-throwing copies; phase 3 spawns Persecutor Liminus, and killing them all turns them on Kullervo before his aerial laser barrages, best dodged from a Kaithe.

disclosures.title: the Orowyrm
disclosures.body: It has no traversal animation, so you climb by grappling up its segments, and a telegraphed energy ring on a ~30 second cycle knocks you off.
